description: This is a unit test source file for the file_utils PHP module within the SuiteCRM project. It uses PHPUnit framework to test various functions related to file handling, directory management, hash computation, and filename sanitization. The class 'file_utilsTest' contains multiple test methods that validate the behavior of utility functions implemented in 'file_utils.php'.

classes.name: file_utilsTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class that tests the functions in 'file_utils.php' used in SuiteCRM. It covers functionalities like path cleaning, cache directory creation, file listing, file hashing, encoding, renaming, and filename sanitation.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the virtual filesystem environment before each test.

methods.name: testclean_path
methods.description: Tests the 'clean_path' function for various path input cases.

methods.name: testcreate_cache_directory
methods.description: Verifies that 'create_cache_directory' creates the directory as expected.

methods.name: testget_module_dir_list
methods.description: Validates that 'get_module_dir_list' returns the expected list of module directories.

methods.name: testremove_file_extension
methods.description: Tests 'remove_file_extension' function with different filename inputs.

methods.name: testwrite_encoded_file
methods.description: Checks if 'write_encoded_file' creates the file correctly with and without specified filename.

methods.name: testcreate_custom_directory
methods.description: Verifies creation of custom directories via 'create_custom_directory'.

methods.name: testmd5DirCompare
methods.description: Tests 'md5DirCompare' for expected empty result in given test case.

methods.name: testgetFiles
methods.description: Validates 'getFiles' function for retrieving file lists with and without pattern filters.

methods.name: testreadfile_chunked
methods.description: Checks the 'readfile_chunked' function for reading file content correctly.

methods.name: testsugar_rename
methods.description: Tests 'sugar_rename' for renaming files, including handling invalid inputs.

methods.name: testfileToHash
methods.description: Verifies 'fileToHash' generates correct MD5 hash and updates session.

methods.name: testhashToFile
methods.description: Checks 'hashToFile' for retrieving filename from a hash.

methods.name: testget_file_extension
